title: Activation Audience Freshness SLA
dataSources: Hightouch syncs (`hightouch:sync`), Census syncs (`census:sync`), Segment/RudderStack delivery events (`segment:delivery`, `rudderstack:delivery`).
app: Reverse-ETL platform APIs and webhooks (Hightouch, Census, Segment, RudderStack) via HEC scripted inputs; sync run and delivery logs.
spl:
index=bi (sourcetype=hightouch:sync OR sourcetype=census:sync) status="completed"
| stats latest(_time) as last_sync by sync_name, destination
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_sync)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>6
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful completion of each reverse-ETL sync and flags audiences/segments that have not refreshed within their freshness SLA.
value: Marketing and sales act on activated audiences; a stale segment wastes ad spend and mis-targets outreach until the sync catches up.
implementation: Ingest sync completion events; schedule hourly and alert when a revenue-critical sync exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of sync by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that the customer lists sent to your marketing and sales tools stay up to date.
